scope: All 47 eligible newly added Reviewed records in the complete source-tree delta. 46 distinct developer advisories; the withdrawn duplicate references its canonical primary advisory.
methodology: Opened public developer API response bodies and compared structured fields and relevant narrative to fixed Reviewed JSON. No PoC or source code executed.

Allowlisted public projections retain exact primary package/range/fix, severity, alias and timestamp fields plus response hashes. Full descriptions, PoCs, reporter contact details and unrelated API metadata are omitted.
Primary inclusive upper bounds are not equated to all possible versions below the next fixed release. Narrative-only extra fixed branches are caveated rather than assigned inferred ranges.
